text:
maria: Quick thread — we want to push a Nimbus Labs customer spotlight this quarter. Deliverables: 1-pager, blog post, short social thread, and a follow-up webinar invite. Need interview, quote sign-off, legal review on benchmarks, and lead routing. Target publish: Mar 31.
ajay: timeline noted. Interview this week ok. Who's coordinating with Nimbus on scheduling?
sylvie: I can run the interview. Wed 10am PT works for me. Prefer 30 mins, record for quotes.
kevin_cs: that's great — I'm the CS contact for Nimbus. I'll intro and prep the metrics they can share. Heads up: they gave us a latency benchmark (p50/p95) vs their previous infra; eng needs to verify numbers before we publish.
maria: thanks. I'll ping eng for verification. @tom_legal — what's needed to get formal approval for quotes/benchmarks from Nimbus? Any template?
tom_legal: Please get a written consent from the customer that: (1) permits use of their name and logo, (2) approves any direct quotes, and (3) signs off on published benchmark figures. Send me the draft copy and their signed doc. If we get it today I can review by EOD tomorrow. Also: include source/date for any numbers.
press-bot: Reminder: logo usage guidelines here: https://redwood.com/logo-guidelines — customer must accept terms.
ajay: For routing: once live, inbound leads should go to growth triage -> AE queue. @hannah_ops can you set up UTM tracking and a Slack alert to #sales-leads?
hannah_ops: On it. I'll create UTM params and a Zap to post to #sales-leads with a short summary and link. Need final landing URL and publish datetime.
sylvie: Draft outreach email to Nimbus below — please tweak: 
```
Subject: Quick approval for Redwood customer spotlight
Hi [Name],
Thanks again for the time. We’d love to feature Nimbus Labs in a short customer spotlight. We’d ask for: a 15–30 min recorded chat, permission to use a one-line hero quote and your logo, and your sign-off on the latency numbers we ran together. We’ll send a draft for approval before publishing.
Best,
Sylvie (Redwood)
```
maria: That looks good. Add a line about the dates we plan to publish and who will own the consent form.
kevin_cs: I'll introduce you to their PM in the intro message and flag the benchmarking numbers that need engineering verification.
ajay: Also note: marketing wants a 2-slide case study (summary + metrics) for webinar promo; can CS prepare a 1-slide metrics snapshot? Sylvie will do the narrative slide.
kevin_cs: Yep — will prepare metrics snapshot. Need to confirm whether we can include end-user count and average session length — customer okayed high-level numbers in the initial convo but we still need explicit sign-off.
tom_legal: Two quick legal notes: 1) Prefer "customer of Redwood Inference" phrasing in marketing copy unless the customer asks for another. 2) Any comparative or benchmark claims must include the test configuration and date (e.g., "measured on c5.4xlarge, Mar 2026"). Please include that in the draft.
maria: Got it. We'll add a small technical note under the metrics. Eng — please verify/confirm config and p50/p95 before we send to customer.
press-bot: FYI — attach a PNG of the Nimbus logo (if provided) and get signed logo usage before final asset export.
hannah_ops: One more operational ask: can we tag the post with utm_source=case-study&utm_campaign=nimbus-q1 so we can attribute leads? I'll standardize utm_medium=social for socials and utm_medium=email for the outreach.
sylvie: Quick checklist for next steps: 
- Kevin to intro Nimbus PM (today)
- Sylvie schedule interview (Wed 10am PT tentative)
- Eng to verify benchmark config/numbers (urgent)
- Tom_legal gets draft + consent form and reviews
- Hannah_ops sets UTM and Slack alert
- Maria to compile final draft for customer approval
Can everyone react with :thumbsup: if good?
ajay: :thumbsup: I'll own the webinar follow-up funnel to AE.
kevin_cs: Intro sent — PM replied, ok to record and will look for draft.
tom_legal: I'll review the draft consent and quote language once received. If anything legal blocks, will flag immediately.
sylvie: Recording confirmed for Wed 10am PT. Will send calendar invite now.
press-bot: Noted — will post a remind to marketing 24h before publish with asset checklist.
maria: Perfect. Thanks all — I’ll assemble the first draft after the interview and tag legal + eng. Expect draft by Mar 26.
sylvie: on it.
hannah_ops: will prepare tracking and zap before publish.
kevin_cs: Thanks — will have metrics ready after interview.
maria: closing loop — last_message_ts 1792000789
